notes: Single-reading days: 43829; days averaged from several readings: 14897.

daily_stat is mixed: in the early record there is one staff-gauge reading per day, so the daily value is that reading; later readings are hourly and then every 10 minutes, and the daily value is their mean. Usual clock time of the single daily reading, by decade: 1860s 08:40; 1870s 08:40; 1880s 08:40; 1890s 08:40; 1900s 08:40; 1910s 08:40; 1920s 08:40; 1930s 08:40; 1940s 08:40; 1950s 08:00; 1960s 08:00; 1970s 08:00; 1980s 08:00.
Readings per day by era (median, first year of each change): 1866: about 1 per day; 1986: about 24 per day; 2011: about 144 per day.
Days are calendar days in UTC+1 (the offset the API returns), for all years.
Raw readings: 1164903. Dropped as fill or gap (value 999999999, empty, or quality code 99): 10.

Identical repeated readings dropped: 4324. On 2192 days two series overlap (1979 to 1987: unchecked hourly values read from recorder charts, and the checked once-a-day staff reading); the checked series is used, and otherwise the more frequent one. Unchecked readings dropped because the same series had a checked reading that day: 2.
Dropped 1 days with fewer than 90% of the usual readings of any series (partial days), for example 2026-10-15.

Kwaliteitswaardecode counts in the raw readings: {'00': 1157596, '25': 7297, '99': 10}. Codes 10, 20 and 25 mark values interpolated in space and/or time; a day is marked estimated when more than half its readings carry one of them. Codes 50 (implausible) and 99 (gap) are dropped.

Statuswaarde counts: {'Gecontroleerd': 780530, 'Definitief': 206111, 'Ongecontroleerd': 178262}. 'Ongecontroleerd' (not yet checked) makes the day provisional; provisional days run 1986-01-01 to 2026-10-14.

Instrument and method periods (first and last year seen): Peilschaal / Indompeling gedurende 1 minuut: 1866 to 1934; other:Vlotterniveaumeter / Visuele aflezing van blad: 1935 to 1987; other:Vlotterniveaumeter - type DNM / Rekenkundig gemiddelde waarde over vorige 10 minuten: 1987 to 1993; other:Vlotterniveaumeter - type DNM / Rekenkundig gemiddelde waarde over vorige 5 en volgende 5 minuten: 1993 to 2026.
The API also returns two readings from January 30 and 31, 1865; the series here starts with the continuous daily record in 1866.

measurement_history.fact: Water levels at Lobith have been measured since 1866.
One staff-gauge reading a day, usually at 08:40; the data list the method as a staff gauge read during a 1-minute immersion.
Float gauge with a chart, read by eye once a day (usually 08:40, then 08:00 from the 1950s).
Hourly values read from recorder charts also exist but were never checked; we use the checked daily reading where both exist (1986 has only the hourly values).
Automatic float gauge with 10-minute averages; hourly values until about 2010, every 10 minutes after that.
Levels are relative to NAP, the national datum, which Rijkswaterstaat checks with precise leveling every 25 to 40 years.
Gauge relocations and any NAP correction at Lobith: not found.

public_notes: Before 1986 each day is a single reading taken around 8 in the morning, so short peaks and dips inside a day are missed; later days are averages of hourly or 10-minute readings. Recent months are not yet checked by Rijkswaterstaat.
